column2: ...Can you hear me? Can you hear my voice...?
I am Grade... One who bears countless names...
You who form a "pair" with the "Moon of destruction," hear me... You are the "Sun of rebirth"...
The Moon of destruction? The Sun of rebirth?

If you wish to know, I shall tell you...\n\nI shall draw you to me, and make all things one... A world freed from every pain, hatred and sorrow... Come with me, and I shall free you from everything...
You got swallowed up by a black thing.
The two of us couldn't do anything, but Honey showed up just in time.
You were wrapped up in that black thing,\n\nsaying "take me with you," so I got a real shock.
When the black thing swallowed me, I met someone who looked just like that! The Demon King... Grade... He's the one behind everything!
N-not yet... The time is not yet ripe... My power... is weak... Soon will come the time of joining... Then I shall gain still greater power...
You shall become mine... and my ambition shall be realized...
I meant to rescue you, {p}-kun, but it looks like you rescued me...
There's still someone I have to rescue...
Ah, {p}-kun! You've been through a lot. I heard all about it.
Man, what a mess out there!
There are rioters all over the ground.\n\nGood thing I had the Hover Pilder.
I'd rather not show you this, {p}-kun... but take a look out the window.
Hand {p} over to the Demon King! That'll stop the Dimension Chain!
The Demon King will make everything right!
The situation could go either way.\n\nPeople driven by fear are turning into a mob. We need to sort out and analyze the situation, quickly.
It seems one unbelievable thing after another has been happening.
When we got to Science City, we couldn't believe our eyes either...
Science City, with all its latest equipment and top people... it's like a ruin!
I'm glad I had your father take Natsu-chan home.
Not a sight I'd want sensitive little Natsuko-chan to see...
What IS this black thing!?\n\nEww, it's so creepy!
There's black things all over the place.
The people are being controlled by black things...?
...And so, we tailed the people being controlled and stumbled right onto the scene of {p}-kun in big trouble!
The people controlled by the black things...\n\nsay they heard someone's voice, don't they? I'm thinking of asking them about it.
I'll be heading out soon too, Professor.
I understand how you feel about {s}-kun. But there's something I want you to understand, too.

The Dimension Chain phenomenon is still going on.\n\nAnd the tragedy the black moon brings has entered its next stage. The black moon has breathed life back into the remains of the "Ma," and they've become black things, black fiends, attacking people.

People possessed by the black fiends turn into rioters, controlled by the Demon King. The damage only spreads... In other words, the Demon King's power is growing! As for how widespread it is, we're waiting on Koji-kun's report...
So that's why Koji-kun went out.
{p}-kun, I want to do everything I can for you and {s}-kun!\n\nBut this situation threatens all of mankind! As director of the Photon Power Lab, I have to work to save mankind!
This is... hard for me too...
Professor Yumi, the Hover Pilder just took off.
Then let's go see how the people controlled by the black things are doing.
...All those people outside want me handed over to the Demon King?
Among the people controlled by the black things, there's apparently a scientist who was studying the Dimension Chain. For some reason, he's stirring them up, saying "Hand him over to the Demon King!"
There's a rumor going around that {s}, who came from the same world as you, was drawn into the black moon.
{s} is a victim too! So am I! I'm a victim too!
I understand how you feel.\n\nBut Professor Yumi said it too, didn't he? The Dimension Chain is starting to drive the world mad...!
Try to understand how Honey feels, too.
Honey's a victim of the Dimension Chain too, y'know? If the Dimension Chain had never happened, Honey's papa would still...
